It is a special language that can be used to communicate with Nigerians and people from English-speaking African countries who do not speak or understand proper English. Any Nigerian that you speak Nigerian pidgin to will feel so happy to hear a language that he/she grew up speaking or hearing.

I am ready to teach you and help you become very fluent in this fun language.

I look forward to our first lesson!

teacher_info.about_teacher: The way I see language learning is a bit philosophical but it also came from my personal experience after being both a student and a teacher for a while. I envision the process of language learning to be similar to the process of growing a tree; you need patience and take care of the plant on a regular basis to get a result that normally can not be pushed ahead of time...But you can always add-in some fertilizers (which are in my case a certain set of technics) to get improved results in terms of time and quality.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
Lessons: I prefer that you book packages to show commitment and also to get along with the nature of the process ( as I explained earlier: expect to practice on a regular basis ! ), I am very flexible and I don't have a problem canceling or reporting lessons... I can also use instant messaging apps like Whatsapp if you feel like learning and practicing on the go. 
Let's talk technics: I am not a big fan of the Pimsleur method unless it's used with some other tools to remember the vocabulary you learned. For example, Anki flashcards. I prefer to rely on the spaced repetition system proposed by apps like Duolingo and Memrise.
